scope: All remaining normal-build cold-core numeric providers, recipes, readers, reports, entrypoints and maintained fabrication drawings in hardware/cold-core-layout, hardware/printed-parts/cold-core and hardware/cut-parts/carbonation.
algorithm_execution: Statically compiled Rust functions, expressions, loops, branches, closures and recipe/document composition. No runtime source compiler, Python AST evaluator or fixed-output substitutions.
python_boundary: Import/type and container marshalling, preserved record shells, opaque third-party library primitive calls and compiled service transport. Placement rotations/translations/matrix multiplication are native Rust; ndarray construction is type marshalling.

fixed_numeric_provider_replies.rule: Original and converted programs received the identical raw JSON provider request/reply pairs. Candidate requests absent from the original recording failed the comparison. Fixtures existed only in the private run directory.

cargo.command: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:$PATH python3 tools/run.py -- /opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin/cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path tools/hsm/cold-core-data/Cargo.toml --bin cold-core-data -j 2

outside_normal_build: Dormant native CadQuery adapters in _coil.py and _reservoir_a_snap.py, and explicit legacy native geometry callbacks in the compiled modules.
Dated physical print records, source snapshots, manual pressure/review/preparation scripts.
performance: No end-to-end performance claim; parent owns combined normal-build integration.
